jobs.title: Recording Engineer
jobs.description:
**Burnside Studios** is hiring recording engineers for Assistant, and Intern levels as we grow our team. If you can hold down a session, we want to talk to you.

We’re an independent studio in the heart of Hollywood working primarily in Hip\-Hop, Reggaeton, Melodic Rap, and R\&B.

We're also partnered with EngineEars, once you're onboarded, we'll set you up with your own profile on the platform.

This runs like an on\-call gig. Work comes in as clients book sessions, so hours will vary week to week, and whoever's ready and available gets the session.

**Positions We're Filling**

**Assistant Engineer**

For engineers who know their way around a session but are still building a client base and reputation.

* Solid grasp of signal flow, mic placement, and session setup
* Can run a session solo with occasional oversight
* Actively building your own mixing/recording chops
* Some paid or unpaid session experience preferred

**Intern**

For engineers just starting out who want real studio hours and mentorship.

* Basic Pro Tools or Logic knowledge
* Reliable, on time, coachable
* No paid experience required
* College credit

**What We Offer**

* Real client sessions from day one (at the appropriate level)
* Room to grow into higher\-paying session work as you level up
* Flexible scheduling, this is a great fit if you're building your own engineering career on the side
* Book our studio at a discount for your own sessions

**Basic Requirements**

* 18\+ and able to work in Hollywood, CA in person
* Reliable transportation to the studio
* Available for on\-call scheduling, including evenings/weekends/holidays
* Strong communication, you'll be responding to booking requests quickly

**Preferred Applicants May Have**

* Prior studio or home\-studio session experience
* Familiarity with Hip\-Hop, Reggaeton, Melodic Rap, or R\&B workflows
* An existing EngineEars profile or client base of your own
* A demo reel or portfolio ready to send

Please provide cover letter and resume.

Pay: $17\.00 \- $25\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 10\.0 – 25\.0 per week

Application Question(s):

* This role requires on\-call availability including evenings, weekends and holidays are you able to commit to that?

Ability to Commute:

* Hollywood, CA 90028 (Required)

Work Location: In person
